name: Expedition Unknown
description: The adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates unsolved iconic stories across the globe.

videos.title: Raw & Unfiltered
videos.overview: Josh answers questions from viewers, reveals new developments in intriguing unfinished investigations, and pulls back the curtain to reveal what really happens behind the scenes in this special episode of Expedition Unknown.

videos.title: Extra Finds: Secrets of Christopher Columbus
videos.overview:
Aired as a Special episode. 2nd part of 2 part Columbus during season 2. Included in DVD set as part of Season 2:

In part 2 of a two-part special, Josh travels from the Dominican Republic and Spain in an attempt to solve the looming mystery of where the bones of Christopher Columbus are truly buried.

videos.title: Legendary Stories: The Real Lewis and Clark

Later, he takes a look at the dangerous details of building the Transcontinental Railroad Also, he exposes secrets of Wyatt Earp, either the greatest lawman or con man in the Wild West.

Josh embarks on a journey around the world to uncover mysteries about Christopher Columbus. First, Josh looks for Columbus' legendary ship, the Santa Maria, and later ventures to find the real remains of the explorer.

videos.title: Nazi Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: Josh Gates heads to Europe to expose the last secrets of the Third Reich. The lost fortune of a Nazi war criminal draws Josh to Austria, where he may need to dive deep to find treasure. Then, he meets a researcher who may have made a historic find that could answer the question: How close was Hitler to having an atomic bomb?

videos.title: Hunt for the Yeti: Return of the Yeti
videos.overview: Beginning in Kathmandu, Josh Gates heads high into the Himalayas of Nepal to obtain scientific evidence of the legendary Yeti. This time his mission is personal, and it will take him into uncharted territory.

videos.title: Hunt for the Yeti: The Monster and the Mountain
videos.overview: In part two of his hunt for the elusive Yeti, Josh Gates ascends higher into the Himalayas to explore caves, examine ancient artifacts and investigate the mystical ties the legendary creature holds with the Nepalese people.

videos.title: Hunt for the Yeti: Out of Thin Air
videos.overview: The hunt for the Yeti continues as Josh Gates' quest takes him from the frozen slopes of Mount Everest to the isolated forests of Bhutan, where Josh uses bait to force a more personal encounter with the creature.

videos.title: Hunt for the Yeti: Unmasking the Myth
videos.overview: In the finale of Josh Gates' hunt for the Yeti, he rafts into the remotest corners of Bhutan to capture some of his best evidence yet of the reclusive creature. Then, Josh returns to the USA, where all of his samples are analyzed to answer the question...is the Yeti real?

videos.title: Further Off the Rails!
videos.overview: Hours of footage are filmed for every episode of Expedition Unknown and some truly wild and zany moments end up on the cutting room floor. Now, Josh Gates compiles the best unseen footage, expanded scenes and never-before-televised moments from his season two adventures into one off-the-rails special.

videos.title: Global Game Show: American Legends
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels across the USA, giving contestants a chance to win up to $500 as they test their knowledge about the country's greatest explorers and most notorious outlaws.

videos.title: Global Game Show: Heroes and Villains
videos.overview: From infamous kings to legendary thieves and notorious pirates, Josh Gates jumps over the pond to test British contestants on their own rich history for the chance to win $500.

videos.title: Global Game Show: Lost Civilizations
videos.overview: From the Mayans of the Yucatan Peninsula to a civilization that disappeared so suddenly they have no name, Josh Gates travels to Texas to quiz contestants on empires that vanished from history for a chance to win cold, hard cash.

videos.title: Global Game Show: Hidden Treasures
videos.overview: Josh Gates takes his quiz show to the Old West with trivia questions about historic treasures that have never been found -- at least not yet! Josh has a cash prize for his clever contestants plus a big bonus for those playing along from home: never-before televised footage from his own treasure hunts...all in this episode of Global Game Show: Hidden Treasures!

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Close Encounters
videos.overview: Part 1 of a special 4 part mini season. A once-in-a-lifetime visit to NASA; evidence of aliens in Chile; a UFO video captured by the military; the largest telescope on Earth. A panel consisting of Josh and his crew discuss the information and events from the first part of the "Hunt For Extraterrestrials" mini-series.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Close Encounters - The Debrief
videos.overview: Part 1 of 4 After Show specials. A panel consisting of Josh and his crew discuss the information and events from the first part of the "Hunt For Extraterrestrials" mini-series.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Ancient Visitors
videos.overview: Part 2 of a special 4 part mini season. Josh's journey continues on remote Easter Island, where ancient alien theorists believe extraterrestrials visited a millennia ago. Then, he goes to the site of a recent meteorite strike in Zimbabwe that could prove life on Earth began in outer space.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Ancient Visitors - The Debrief
videos.overview: Part 2 of 4 After Show specials. The hour-long episode will revisit Gates' journey in a candid, behind-the-scenes forum, as Gates and his team dig deeper into their astounding findings, further analyze key evidence and reveal never-before-seen footage from the expedition.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: UFOs Over England
videos.overview: Part 3 of a special 4 part mini season. The hunt for alien life continues in Zimbabwe, where Josh interviews witnesses from one of the largest UFO sightings in modern history. Then, in England, he investigates the infamous case that has become known as "Europe's Roswell."

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: UFOs Over England - The Debrief
videos.overview: Part 3 of 4 After Show specials. The hour-long episode will revisit Gates' journey in a candid, behind-the-scenes forum, as Gates and his team dig deeper into their astounding findings, further analyze key evidence and reveal never-before-seen footage from the expedition.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Roswell Revealed
videos.overview: Part 4 of a special 4 part mini season. Josh's epic search for extraterrestrial life comes to a close in the USA, where a legendary investigation team brings him to a hot case in Arkansas. Then, he visits with a researcher who may have new information on the mother of all UFOs.

videos.title: Hunt for Extraterrestrials: Roswell Revealed - The Debrief

videos.title: Search for the Afterlife: Heaven and Hell and Beyond
videos.overview: Seeking evidence of the afterlife, Josh Gates enters an ancient Roman "Gate to Hell" that still claims victims. In New York, a medical doctor shows how consciousness survives death. In California, a medium shocks Josh with a message from beyond.

videos.title: After the Search - Talking with the Dead
videos.overview: Part 1 of 4 After Show specials. Behind-the-scenes secrets direct from HQ are featured, including a spiritual medium who speaks with the dead, unseen footage from Josh's Gate to Hell dive, and a medical doctor who claims evidence of an afterlife.

videos.title: Search for the Afterlife: Death and Beyond
videos.overview: Josh talks with Dr. Deepak Chopra about reincarnation, explores a path to Islamic paradise, and faces a man possessed by an evil spirit.

videos.title: After the Search - Josh's Past Life
videos.overview: Part 2 of 4 After Show specials. Josh shares exclusive footage from an actual exorcism along with real-life exorcist Brother Carlos Oliviera. Josh undergoes a past-life regression through hypnosis and reveals incredible details of a former life at sea.

videos.title: Search for the Afterlife: Edge of Existence
videos.overview: From ancient tombs to the latest bio-technology, humans have always been obsessed with cheating death.Josh visits a tribe in Indonesia where people live with mummies, and a cryonics lab in Russia at the cutting edge of freezing humans for the future.

videos.title: After the Search - Journey to the Dark Side
videos.overview: Part 3 of 4 After Show specials. Josh shares a footage and insights into his journey to the brink of the afterlife after drinking a mysterious drug concocted by Amazonian shamans. Also, Josh meets the leader of a movement attempting to beat death through technology.

videos.title: Search for the Afterlife: Crossing Over the Edge
videos.overview: A shaman in the Amazon takes Josh on an ayahuasca trip to the brink of the Afterlife. A team of investigators lead Josh into one of the world's most haunted places.

videos.title: After the Search - Ghost in the Machine
videos.overview: Part 4 of 4 After Show specials. Josh reveals exclusive footage and personal insights from his hunt for ghosts with a team of investigators on board the RMS Queen Mary. After his life-changing experience with Ayhuasca, Josh gives his verdict on his own brushes with the afterlife.

videos.overview: Josh Gates heads to an active dig site in Egypt, where he joins famous archaeologist Dr. Zahi Hawass on the cusp of an incredible discovery: the mummy of an ancient High Priest.

videos.title: After the Hunt: D-Day Revealed
videos.overview: At EXU Headquarters, Josh Gates is joined by historian Gary Sterne and military veteran Captain Dale Dye to analyze unseen footage, unravel new insights, and dig into more secrets of D-Day.

videos.title: America's Mysteries Uncovered
videos.overview: Josh Gates and Expedition X investigators Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres dig into unseen footage captured in their investigations into disappearance of Northwest Flight 2501 and the Mothman.

videos.title: Lost Predator of the Deep
videos.overview:
Alongside fellow paleontologists and shark experts, Josh Gates dives into shark-infested waters to find out what happened to the mighty Megalodon.

*This is a re-run of the episode "Expedition Unknown: Megalodon" (s00e110) just with a different name.*

videos.title: After The Hunt: Unknown Ancestors
videos.overview: Josh Gates and the Expedition X team gather to discuss their Cambodian adventure, and Josh goes in depth on his African trip to investigate the origins of humanity.

videos.title: After The Hunt: Uncovering Humanity
videos.overview: Josh Gates and the Expedition X team are joined by Ghost Nation's Jason Hawes to delve into strange occurrences on The Island Of The Dolls. Josh continues his look at the first humans with a hands-on demonstration of tool making.

videos.title: After the Hunt: Mysteries Beneath Our Feet
videos.overview: Josh Gates digs into the night's Expedition Unknown and Expedition X, including never-before-seen footage from the X team’s trip into Mammoth Caves and in-depth interviews with guest expert investigators about Josh's search for Boudica's lost treasure.

videos.title: After the Hunt: Diving Deeper Looking Higher
videos.overview: Josh Gates and the Expedition X team present new evidence of extraterrestrials from their investigation in Mount Adams, Washington. Then, Josh and his crew dive deeper into the hunt for the Buzzard's hidden pirate treasure.

videos.title: After The Hunt-Uncovering Land and Sea
videos.overview: Josh Gates and the Expedition X team review ghostly evidence and never-before-aired footage from the jungles of Brazil. Then, Josh and his crew delve into theories of what causes so many mysterious occurrences in the Bermuda Triangle.

videos.title: Christopher Columbus Pt2
videos.overview: The search for Christopher Columbus continues with finding his missing remains. Gates follows his five-century voyage across two continents to search for his final resting place believed to be at Columbus Lighthouse in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic or at Cathedral of Saint Mary of the See in Seville, Spain, both countries laying claim to his bones.

videos.title: Christopher Columbus Pt1
videos.overview: Josh visits Portugal and Haiti to discover whether Christopher Columbus was history's greatest hero or villain. He also hopes to find the remnants of Columbus' legendary flagship, the Santa Maria.

videos.title: Amelia Earhart
videos.overview: In the 2-hour season premiere of Expedition Unknown, adventurer Josh Gates hunts down new evidence on the disappearance of Amelia Earhart. He treks to uncharted tribal lands in Papua New Guinea and ends his journey in Fiji, hoping to uncover the pilot’s remains.

videos.title: Temple of Doom
videos.overview: Josh travels to the remote and land-mine-riddled jungles of Cambodia to investigate the lost city of the Khmer Empire and search for a mystical relic that gave its god king the power to incinerate his enemies more than 1,000 years ago.

videos.title: World's 8th Wonder
videos.overview: Josh is on the trail of Russia’s missing Amber Panels, priceless pieces of art stolen by the Nazis during WWII. After starting in St. Petersburg, Russia, and getting exposed to the local culture, Josh makes a brief pit stop in Berlin to marvel at the city’s amazing turnaround since the end of the Cold War.

videos.title: The Legend of Jesse James
videos.overview: Josh tries putting the legend of Jesse James' missing gold to rest, as he searches the American Midwest, searching for the treasure.

videos.title: City of Gold
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels through Peru in search for the legendary Incan lost city of Paititi. His journey takes him from the historic Cusco, to the heights of Machu Picchu, and finally into the Amazon's dark and mysterious jungles.

videos.title: Viking Sunstone
videos.overview: Josh travels to England and Norway to unlock the secrets of the Viking sunstone, a mystic crystal the Vikings used to conquer the seas. Before testing it, he explores a crypt in a Nordic church and descends 1,000 feet into a deserted mine.

videos.title: Captain Morgan's Lost Gold
videos.overview: Josh joins archaeologists in Panama as they search for the Satisfaction, the sunken flagship of legendary pirate Captain Henry Morgan. But first he must understand the man behind the rum who attacked Panama City looking for treasure. He also searches one of many shipwrecks near Fort San Lorenzo at the reef, where Morgan's ship ran aground.

videos.title: Code to Gold
videos.overview: Josh scours the Virginia backcountry in search of the legendary Thomas Beale treasure, which would be worth millions today. Since encrypted codes are hiding its whereabouts, Josh takes a detour to Philadelphia to uncover missing pieces of the puzzle.

videos.title: Mayan Apocalypse
videos.overview: While investigating the fall of the remarkable Mayan Empire, Josh unearths human skulls and ancient Mayan sacrificial altars in the caverns underneath the jungles and ruins of Mexico.

videos.title: Secrets of the Nazca
videos.overview: Josh travels to Peru to investigate the giant geoglyphs drawn into the earth by the ancient Nazca tribes and while studying newly found lines joining a Nazca psychadelic ritual, Josh discovers the meaning behind the mysterious tracings.

videos.title: Samurai Sword of Power
videos.overview: Josh searches for the missing mystical Honjo sword in Japan in ancient shrines hidden in the mountains and underground tunnels.

videos.title: Curse of the Golden Bell
videos.overview: The ancient cursed Golden Bell of King Dhammazedi.

videos.title: The Quest for King Arthur
videos.overview: In the Season 2 premiere, Josh scours the United Kingdom to find the real-life King Arthur.

videos.title: Genghis Khan's Tomb
videos.overview: Josh Gates journeys into the heart of Mongolia in search of the fabled lost tomb of Genghis Khan.

videos.title: Blackbeard's Hidden Gold
videos.overview: Josh explores the ocean floor of the Cayman Islands and the coasts of North Carolina in his quest to find the lost treasure of the legendary pirate Blackbeard.

videos.title: Hunting Vampires
videos.overview: Gates digs up the truth behind vampire legends. His travels start at Curtea Veche in Romania, where he learns about Vlad the Impaler, the inspiration behind Dracula. Then off to Marotinu de Sus, a Romanian village, where six men desecrated a fresh grave believing it to be a "strigoi". He ends in Perperikon, Bulgaria to examine a supposed vampire grave.

videos.title: The Real Robin Hood
videos.overview: Josh travels the English countryside on a mission to learn if Robin Hood was a real man and if he's the hero from the legends or a murderous outlaw. He dives into 800 years of ballads and stories at London's British Library, explores tunnels and caves beneath Nottingham, and joins historians in search of Hood's grave, first in Kirklees Priory, Yorkshire, and lastly at a churchyard in Loxley, where researchers believe an outlaw named Roger Godberd who was the real Robin Hood is buried.

videos.title: Finding Fenn's Fortune
videos.overview: Josh Gates joins the hunt for for a $2,000,000 treasure. He attempts to decode the clues of the modern day treasure's location by following a cryptic poem, leading him deep into the harsh Rocky Mountains.

videos.title: Japan's Atlantis
videos.overview: Gates goes to the ruins of Yonaguni Island, the westernmost Japanese island on the East China Sea, to determine whether the undersea structures are geologic or man-made. The Yonaguni Monument discoverer, Kihachiro Aratake, dives with Josh, showing him the undersea area with cut steps leading up to a level platform. Josh takes a rock sample for geologic analysis. In Osaka, archaeologist Michio Maezano shows Josh an ancient rock tomb. It proves that ancient people could have carved the Yonaguni structures, then an earthquake could have sunk them.

videos.title: True Cross of Christ
videos.overview: Gates searches for the True Cross. This relic, said to have mystical healing powers, has been lost for 2,000 years. Gates visits Jerusalem, Israel and Istanbul, Turkey, to find if the cross or fragments of it still exist. The cross was cut into three pieces on the orders of Empress Helena. He examines this legend at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in the Old City where the tomb of Jesus is located and where he was crucified. Then he learns more about crucifixion in Tel Aviv, and discovers ancient cross wall carvings at the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem.

videos.title: The Sultan's Heart
videos.overview: Gates hunts for the Heart of Suleiman the Magnificent, ruler of the Ottoman Empire in the 16th century. When Suleiman died in 1566 during a battle in Hungary, his body was brought back to Istanbul, but not before a ritual was performed involving the removal of his heart being placed in a gold container and buried beneath his tent. The Sultan's followers believed his heart has magical powers and continues to beat, waiting to be returned to its host. The town of Tubek was built over the burial site to honor the Sultan.

videos.title: Africa's Gold Hoard
videos.overview: Gates travels to South Africa to search for the missing Kruger Millions, the gold coins of the country's entire financial reserve. The treasure vanished overnight after South African President Paul Kruger loaded the hoard on a train and it vanished overnight in 1900 during the Boer War.

videos.title: Kalahari Desert's Lost City
videos.overview: Gates searches for a lost city in the Kalahari Desert in Africa. First discovered by circus pioneer The Great Farini in 1885, he supposedly came across the ruins of a lost city half buried in the scorching sands. Those who followed in his footsteps came up empty-handed and claimed it a hoax, while even some vanished. Today, a modern explorer launched an all new expedition which Gates joins.

videos.title: Yamashita's Gold
videos.overview: Gates searches for Yamashita's Gold, millions of dollars in Southeast Asian gold and jewels that was looted by Japan and covertly transported to the Philippines under the direction of Japanese general Tomoyuki Yamashita during World War II. The fortune was hidden by gangsters, military generals, and a secret organization in tunnels and caves somewhere in the conquered country. But the treasure was lost when the Allies won the war, until a treasure hunter found part of it in 1970 and has been searching for it ever since.

videos.title: Columbus: Legend or Liar?
videos.overview:
Josh embarks on a journey around the world to uncover mysteries about Christopher Columbus. First, Josh looks for Columbus' legendary ship, the Santa Maria, and later ventures to find the real remains of the explorer.

This episode is a condensed special using footage from 2 previous episodes of Expedition Unknown about Christopher Columbus.  S02E07 - Secrets of Christopher Columbus - December 2, 2015

S02E08 - Columbus Unearthed - December 9, 2015

videos.title: Searching for Shangri-La
videos.overview: Gates searches high in the Himalayas for Shangri-La. He learns of its legend as a hidden utopia. In the most remote reaches of Nepal near the border of Tibet is an area known as the Mustang, an area that's been closed off to the outside world and the passage of time. But now Josh and his fellow archaeologists have been granted access to explore it. He finds out secrets hiding inside its sky caves, man-made chambers carved into cliff walls.

videos.title: Shangri-La Found
videos.overview: After learning about the ancient Buddhist realm of Shambhala in Kathmandu and exploring the skycaves, Gates continues his search for the real Shangri-La. This time, he discovers a rock tower used for human burials and filled with bones dating back to 800 A.D. Next, he travels to Lo Manthang for another day of investigation in the Martzon area to climb a cave system called Pumamba, which is linked to the legend. Then he heads to Chuusang, a remote cave monastery that has never been excavated before.

videos.title: Lost Mexican City
videos.overview: Josh searches for the mysterious civilization of Teotihuacan, a lost empire left behind in Mexico with soaring pyramids dedicated to the gods, imposing temples, and a treasure trove of cryptic art. He seeks answers on who these indigenous people were, finds out their secrets that have been buried for 2,000 years, and what they left behind.

videos.title: Incan King's Mummy
videos.overview: Josh searches for the lost mummy of Atahualpa, the last great king of the Incan empire, hidden high in the Andes Mountains and in the jungles and highlands of Ecuador. His reign ended when Spanish Conquistador Francisco Pizarro murdered him and brought the Inca civilization to an end. But the emperor obtained great power and wealth, even in death. His body was mummified in a sacred ritual to give him supernatural sway over the world of the living. Then, his body vanished. Archaeologists have been searching ever since.

videos.title: Nazi Gold Train
videos.overview: Josh exposes Nazi secrets as he searches for the lost fortune of war criminal Adolf Hitler's billions in gold, art and relics stolen on his orders by the Nazis to suport his doomsday weapon during World War II. They also built networks of hidden tunnels and bunkers. Today, archaeologists use modern technology to recover treasure and excavate the underground legacy of the Third Reich. On his journey, Josh joins them, first finding answers in Germany, identifying gold in a Nazi train hidden inside a mountain in Poland. Then, in Austria, he explores a subterranean facility to a top secret lab to build a war machine.

videos.title: Hitler's Atomic Secrets
videos.overview: The search for Nazi secrets and their stolen gold continues in the darkest corners of history; both underground and underwater. This time, Josh dives for relics of Nazi foreign minister Joachim Von Ribbontrop who dumped his family's entire fortune into the dark and deep waters of Lake Fuschlsee in the Austrian Alps. In order to learn if the Nazis where building an atomic bomb, he starts his quest for answers in Hitler's hometown of Linz. Then, he stops at the Mauthausen-Gusen concentration camp memorial in Sankt Georgen an der Gusen to pay his respects to the hundreds of thousands who perished here. He also explores 25 miles of tunnel under the Bergkristall complex, the largest secret underground facility ever built. It was designed by SS General Hans Kammler to oversee the Nazis nuclear project.

videos.title: Plummer's Gold
videos.overview: Josh Gates sets off for gold rush country to search for the lost fortune of a notorious Montana sheriff. During his investigation, Josh explores hidden cave systems and blows open a mine that's been sealed for over a century.

videos.title: The Lost Tomb of Attila the Hun
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels to Hungary to join three separate archeological teams looking for the lost tomb of Attila the Hun. Legends and ancient texts lead the search from the bottom of the Danube to the mountain forests just outside of Budapest.

videos.title: The Vanished Empire
videos.overview: Josh travels to Greece to explore Europe's first superpower and how it disappeared on the Mediterranean island of Crete.

videos.title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke
videos.overview: Josh Gates joins leading archeologists as they investigate America's first missing-persons case, The Lost Colony of Roanoke. Following newly discovered clues, he'll reach new heights as he digs for answers to this over 400-year-old mystery.

videos.title: Cloning the Woolly Mammoth
videos.overview: One of the most iconic creatures of the Ice Age, the Woolly Mammoth, has gone extinct and Josh and a team search for enough DNA to clone a woolly mammoth.

videos.title: Journey to the Ice Age
videos.overview: Josh retrieves bone samples from the massive Batagay crater and gets DNA results to find out if the woolly mammoth will walk the earth again.

videos.title: Cracking the D.B. Cooper Case
videos.overview: Josh Gates sets off on an expedition to crack the mystery behind the perpetrator of the only unsolved plane hijacking in U.S. history.

videos.title: Lasseter's Gold
videos.overview: Josh Gates sets off deep into the Australian Outback, following the footsteps of legendary explorer Harold Lasseter, who claims to have found a vast field of gold.

videos.title: Tracking Tasmania's Tiger
videos.overview: Josh Gates ventures to Australia's island state of Tasmania to investigate sightings of the supposedly extinct Thylacine, also known as the Tasmanian Tiger.

videos.title: Captain Kidd's Treasure
videos.overview: Josh Gates retraces the footsteps of the legendary Captain Kidd in the hopes of finding his buried treasure; from the East Coast to the Caribbean, the search takes him to a real pirate shipwreck and to the island hideout of the notorious buccaneer.

videos.title: Africa's Cursed Lake of Gold
videos.overview: Josh Gates journeys to the wilds of Namibia to embark on a treacherously deep dive in Lake Otjikoto for a long lost World War I treasure.

videos.title: The Ark of the Covenant
videos.overview: Josh Gates follows in the footsteps of Indiana Jones as he searches in Israel and Ethiopia for the lost Ark of the Covenant, the sacred relic said to contain the Ten Commandments and possess extraordinary powers.

videos.title: England's Vanished Crown Jewels
videos.overview: Gates tries to find the lost treasure of King John. He explores the marshlands of England to find the king's crown jewels, which were swept away in a freak tidal surge in the 13th century.

videos.title: Corsica's Nazi Treasure
videos.overview: Gates hunts for the hidden treasure of Erwin Rommel, a Nazi general who plundered the wealth of North Africa as his tank corps fled the continent. The search brings Gates to never-explored underground lakes and undersea relics of World War II.

videos.title: Italy's Barbarian Booty
videos.overview: To find the plundered riches of the Roman Empire, Gates looks for the tomb of the Visigoth king Alaric in Italy. The hunt extends from the capital of Rome to the southern city of Cosenza, where the mayor is spearheading an effort to find the tomb.

videos.title: India's Atlantis
videos.overview: Gates travels to India in search of Dwarka, a mythical kingdom swallowed by the ocean. To find evidence that the golden city is real, Gates dives into the Arabian Sea and visits a dig site.

videos.title: Lost Spanish Fortune Found!
videos.overview: Gates travels down to the coast of Florida and to Cuba in search of a sunken treasure from a fleet of Spanish ships that were sunk in 1715; the hunt takes him deep into the Atlantic and the National Archives of Cuba.

videos.title: Viking Secrets
videos.overview: From Denmark and Iceland to the United States and Canada, Josh Gates treads into Viking territory in an effort to unlock answers to their most enduring secrets, including how they attained and sustained their power and how far they really traveled.

videos.title: Vikings in America
videos.overview: Josh traces the Vikings' westward expansion from the volcanic landscape of Iceland to a mysterious settlement in Greenland; he aims to find out if the Vikings landed in the United States more than 500 years before any other Europeans.

videos.title: Origins of Stonehenge
videos.overview: Josh travels to his ancestral home of Great Britain to explore the origins of Stonehenge. From high in the air to deep under the sea, he finds an unexpected network of monuments that could have inspired one of history's most mystical locations.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Josh travels across the United States to find the treasures featured in the cryptic 1982 book "The Secret"; Josh meets with members of the book's cult following, who each think they are on the verge of locating one of the 10 remaining treasures.

videos.title: Butch Cassidy's Lost Loot
videos.overview: Josh immerses himself in Wild West lore on a quest to find Butch Cassidy's missing money; he traces the iconic outlaw's footsteps through Colorado, Utah and Nevada, eventually learning he may have to find the man himself to locate the lost loot.

videos.title: Hunt for the Metal Library
videos.overview: Josh travels through the jungles of Ecuador to explore the watery depths of Tayos Cave for a legendary set of metal plates believed to be created by an advanced ancient civilization.

videos.title: Great Women of Ancient Egypt
videos.overview: Josh journeys through the land of the Nile to uncover the buried secrets of three of the most powerful and elusive women in ancient Egypt -- Hatshepsut, Nefertiti and Cleopatra.

videos.title: Egypt's Lost Queens
videos.overview: Josh Gates continues his journey through Egypt to unearth the secrets and possibly the final resting places of Nefertiti and Cleopatra.

videos.title: Global Game Show: Out of This World
videos.overview: Josh Gates' Global Game Show goes all over the planet but this time he's going out of this world by giving his contestants the opportunity to win big on the topic of extraterrestrials. Players at home can win a big prize too, plus a bonus look at footage that never aired in the original Expedition Unknown episodes.

videos.title: Secrets of Brother XII
videos.overview: Josh Gates attempts to uncover a treasure left behind by the Aquarian Foundation, an isolated, insidious cult led by the notorious leader known as Brother XII.

videos.title: Pyramid of Legends
videos.overview: Archaeologist Dr. Richard Hansen joins Josh and his team to venture deep into the Guatemalan rainforest to find the hidden tombs of the mysterious Snake Kings in the ancient Mayan city of El Mirador.

videos.title: Lost City of El Mirador
videos.overview: Josh concludes his investigation into the mysterious Maya city of El Mirador, from the possible burial of the elusive Snake Kings to uncovering the secrets behind the fall of one of history's greatest ancient cities.

videos.title: Nazis in Argentina
videos.overview: Josh ventures to Argentina, where many Nazi SS officers escaped to after World War II.

videos.title: Lost Gold of Jean Lafitte
videos.overview: Josh ventures to the American south to uncover the mystery of real-life buccaneer Jean Laffite and the location of his hidden treasure.

videos.title: Mahogany Ship
videos.overview: Josh goes down under to search along Australia's infamous Shipwreck Coast for the missing Mahogany Ship.

videos.title: Hunt for the Ruby Slippers
videos.overview: Josh investigates the theft of one of the most iconic pieces of Hollywood memorabilia of all time — the ruby slippers worn by Judy Garland in the 1939 classic movie, The Wizard of Oz.

videos.title: Solved: Mystery of the Lost Ruby Slippers
videos.overview: In an extended episode with new footage, Profiles in History CEO Joe Maddalena and Josh Gates assist in the recovery of stolen ruby slippers from the movie, "The Wizard of Oz." Investigators have been searching for them ever since they were stolen from the Judy Garland Museum in 2005.

videos.title: Heaven and Hell
videos.overview: Seeking evidence of the afterlife, Josh Gates enters an ancient Roman "Gate to Hell" that still claims victims. A medical doctor demonstrates how consciousness survives death, and a gifted medium shocks Josh with a message from beyond the grave.

videos.title: Death and Beyond
videos.overview: To crack the code of reincarnation, Josh seeks out expert Dr. Deepak Chopra, who advises him to investigate the phenomenon firsthand in India. He explores an Islamic path to paradise in Turkey and faces a man possessed by an evil spirit.

videos.title: Edge of Existence
videos.overview: From ancient tombs to the latest bio-technology, humans have always been obsessed with cheating death. Josh visits a tribe in Indonesia where people live with mummies and a Russian cryonics lab at the cutting edge of freezing humans for the future.

videos.title: Crossing Over
videos.overview: They say you only live once, but can we return from the abyss? In the Amazon, Josh meets a shaman who takes him on a trip to the brink of the afterlife. Then a team of investigators guide him into one of the most haunted places on Earth.

videos.title: Egypt Live
videos.overview: Live from the middle of the Egyptian desert, inside a great underground tomb complex, a sealed sarcophagus may contain the identity of a mummy who has remained a mystery for 3000 years.

videos.title: Deciphering the Last Nazi Code
videos.overview: Josh Gates ventures into the former Third Reich in search of an elusive Nazi fortune hidden with a code allegedly created by Hitler's private secretary, and embedded into a piece of sheet music.

videos.title: Mysteries of Jesus
videos.overview: Josh Gates searches land and sea for the lost fortune of legendary pirate Sir Francis Drake. Joining treasure hunters and maritime archaeologists, Josh hunts for a lost cache of Spanish gold and the remains of Drake himself.

videos.title: Atlantis of the Andes
videos.overview: Josh Gates dives into a mystery below South America's Lake Titicaca. During the investigation, Josh discovers multiple structures of the ancient Tiwanaku people, including ruins hidden in the lake's depths, dubbed "The Atlantis of the Andes".

videos.title: Lost Gold of Scotland
videos.overview: Hunting for a lost cache of gold, Josh Gates heads to the Scottish Highlands. His search focuses on a huge gold reserve hidden after the Jacobite Uprising of 1745 and never recovered. Josh joins treasure hunters chasing a new lead across the Highlands.

videos.title: Ghost Ship of the Great Lakes
videos.overview: Josh Gates tackles an enduring maritime mystery, the first ship to be lost in the Great Lakes, the Griffon. Using a state of the art two-man submersible, Josh dives in to find a ship so elusive it's known as "The Holy Grail of Shipwrecks."

videos.title: Legend of the Crystal Skull
videos.overview: Josh Gates takes on Central America's jungles to investigate the legendary crystal skull discovered by a renowned adventurer who was the inspiration for Indiana Jones. Josh probes whether the skull is an invaluable relic or archaeology's tallest tale.

videos.title: America's Lost WWII Hero
videos.overview: Josh Gates explores the case of lost World War II hero Gertrude "Tommy" Tompkins of the Women Air Force Service Pilots, who went missing when her P-51 Mustang crashed. Josh joins search teams using cutting-edge technology to bring the lost hero home.

videos.title: The Hunt for the Golden Owl
videos.overview: Josh Gates stalks prey that has eluded capture for 25 years, the Golden Owl. A book of riddles gives cryptic clues to where the Owl statuette, worth half a million dollars, is hidden. Josh joins treasure hunters using new leads to chase the fortune.

videos.title: Mysteries of the Dead Sea Scrolls
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels to the Holy Land to unearth the mystery of the Dead Sea Scrolls with an archaeologist who has discovered new ones; Josh sees cutting-edge technology restore scroll fragments in a way that could change how people read the Bible.

videos.title: Treasure of the Copper Scroll
videos.overview: Josh Gates investigates a unique Dead Sea Scroll etched with riddles that could lead to an ancient treasure. Following new leads, Josh treks into the punishing Jordanian desert in search of the potential fortune.

videos.title: Chasing the Fortune of Sir Francis Drake
videos.overview: Josh Gates searches land and sea for the lost fortune of legendary pirate Sir Francis Drake; joining treasure hunters and maritime archaeologists, Josh hunts for a lost cache of Spanish gold and the remains of Drake himself.

videos.title: Mystery of Dead Mountain
videos.overview: Braving sub-zero conditions of Siberia, Josh Gates investigates the Dyatlov Pass incident, during which nine hikers died under suspicious circumstances in 1959.

videos.title: Siberia's Coldest Case
videos.overview: Josh Gates concludes his in-depth investigation of the Dyatlov Pass incident; taking on Dead Mountain's brutal conditions, Josh and two investigators retrace the last steps of the hikers; a big discovery could finally solve the mystery.

videos.title: The Search For Florida's Lost Pirate
videos.overview: Josh Gates sets sail for Florida chasing the long-lost treasure of Jose Gaspar. Josh joins marine archaeologists and treasure hunters working to crack the mysteries of the pirate's life so they can find the riches he left behind.

videos.title: Hunt for the Chupacabra
videos.overview: In Puerto Rico, Josh Gates explores caves and treks through dense jungles in search of the chupacabra; working with a wildlife biologist, a veterinarian and an investigator, Josh explores a recent wave of attacks to separate fact from fiction.

videos.title: Lost Tomb of the Mummy
videos.overview: Josh Gates heads to an active dig site in Egypt, where he joins famous archaeologist Dr. Zahi Hawass on the cusp of an incredible discovery: the mummy of an ancient High Priest.

videos.title: Chasing the Snake Kings
videos.overview: With a potential new breakthrough in the search for a Snake King tomb, Josh Gates returns to the jungles of Guatemala and the archaeological dig at the ancient Mayan city of El Mirador; the archeologists attempt to pinpoint the tomb's location.

videos.title: Cracking the Secret
videos.overview: Josh Gates is on a nation-wide treasure hunt to solve a mystery no one has cracked for 40 years: The Secret. Josh travels coast-to-coast and back in time using cutting edge augmented reality and tapping into a network of obsessed Secret detectives.

videos.title: Gold Rush Of The Atlantic
videos.overview: Josh Gates has a fresh lead on the massive lost treasure of the shipwrecked 1715 Spanish fleet. Josh returns to the waters of Florida's Atlantic coast and dives in with a new expedition that uses the latest high tech to locate the fleet's flagship.

videos.title: Search For The Sultan's Heart
videos.overview: Four years after Josh Gates went on a journey to find the lost heart of Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent, he travels to the newly rediscovered town of Turbek for some shocking new revelations about the case.

videos.title: The Secret Solved
videos.overview: Josh Gates cuts another expedition short to return to his hometown of Boston and pursue the strongest lead in decades for a 40 year old treasure hunt dubbed: The Secret. Following the amazing solve of a Boston puzzle maker could lead him to the very prize he has sought himself for years.

videos.title: Digging Into D-Day
videos.overview: Josh Gates touches down in Normandy to investigate battles on land, air, and sea. The expedition reveals a Nazi threat greater than ever imagined, unearthing a massive German bunker complex buried for 75 years.

videos.title: Searching for America's Lost Flight
videos.overview: Josh Gates investigates the most mysterious airline disaster in American history -- searching for why Northwest Flight 2501 vanished, taking the lives of all 58 people on board.

videos.title: The Hunt for Our Ancient Ancestors
videos.overview: In this expansive, two-part investigation, Josh Gates travels the globe attempting to solve the most fundamental mystery of all -- humanity's origins. How did we survive to the modern day? And what does that mean for our future?

videos.title: Revealing Our Ancient Ancestors
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels to Africa to get up close and personal with a distant relative and scale dangerous cliffs all to answer one question: Where did humans come from?

videos.title: The Warrior Queen's Treasure
videos.overview: Searching across England, Josh Gates unearths a cache of ancient treasure as he chases the legend of Queen Boudica, the legendary Celtic queen who nearly defeated the invading Roman army 2,000 years ago.

videos.title: The Fortune of the Buzzard
videos.overview: Josh Gates takes on the Indian Ocean's punishing waters as he chases the lost treasure of Olivier Levasseur, AKA "The Buzzard," rumored to be worth more than a billion dollars.

videos.title: Mysteries of Bermuda Triangle
videos.overview: Josh Gates dives into the mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle. His investigation leads him to the ocean floor, the skies above and even the edge of space as he tackles some of the most intriguing disappearances in history.

videos.title: Revealing the Triangle
videos.overview: In the conclusion of his epic investigation, Josh Gates uses cutting-edge technology to investigate the Triangle's most infamous shipwreck and lost flights. Will he find answers to just how the Triangle works or will it forever remain a mystery?

videos.title: Dillinger's Lost Loot
videos.overview: Josh joins the hunt for John Dillinger's fortune that's never been found.

videos.title: The Lost Avenger
videos.overview: A three-man crew of Navy pilots training for World War 2 crashed into the Pacific Ocean 75 years ago. Josh Gates teams up with Project Recover on a daring mission to find their plane and bring closure for the three souls who have never been found.

videos.title: Ransom in the Sky
videos.overview: With brand-new evidence Josh looks to finally crack the DB Cooper case, America's only unsolved skyjacking. A deathbed confession and cutting-edge forensics have Josh hot on the trail of the $200,000 ransom that's never been recovered.

videos.title: The Quest for El Dorado
videos.overview: Josh Gates treks deep into Colombia's deadly jungle to unravel the El Dorado myth and retrace the steps of Spanish conquistadors. Josh meets with the tribe who inspired the legend of a city of gold and unearths their treasure in a surprising location.

videos.title: Uncovering the Golden City
videos.overview: The hunt for El Dorado is Josh's most grueling journey ever and one of the crew tumbles into a raging river. When cutting-edge aerial scans reveal a lost city, they push into the jungle to uncover El Dorado and the gold that comes with it.

videos.title: America's Titanic
videos.overview: Josh dives the Atlantic in search of millions in lost coins sunk with America's Titanic. In 1838, a steamship carrying some of America's wealthiest citizens exploded off the Carolina coast. New sonar scans may lead to the wreckage and the lost fortune.

videos.title: Buried Secrets of Hitler
videos.overview: With word of an urgent lead, Josh jets to Poland to join in the opening of a secret Nazi tunnel system dug into a dormant volcano. Josh helps a local team tear away a stone wall built by the Germans in the last days of World War II.

videos.title: Nazi Buried Secrets
videos.overview: Josh Gates hunts for Third Reich secrets as he searches for stolen art in a flooded tunnel complex, tries to decode an officer's diary pointing to tons of plundered Nazi gold and visits the ruins of a city burned to ashes in the final days of WWII.

videos.title: Dalton Gang's Outlaw Fortune
videos.overview: Josh Gates heads to the Wild West in search of the hidden loot heisted by infamous lawmen turned criminals, the Dalton Gang. Re-tracing the Gang's last steps and investigating their final, deadly shoot-out, Josh chases a fortune worth millions today.

videos.title: Lindbergh's Lost Rivals
videos.overview: Josh Gates goes on a worldwide search for aviation's most famous lost plane. Just before Lindbergh made history, two rivals attempted a Paris to New York transatlantic flight. Chasing new clues, Josh scours two continents to find the lost "White Bird."

videos.title: The Hunt for Templar Treasure
videos.overview: On the trail of the secretive Knights Templar, Josh chases the legendary warriors' lost fortune including the coveted Holy Grail. In England, Josh digs in to find a Templar buried tunnel. Then, he travels to Poland to excavate a rare Templar gravesite.

videos.title: The Bootlegger's Millions
videos.overview: Josh Gates hunts the lost fortune of infamous bootlegger Dutch Schultz.

videos.title: Escaping the Rock
videos.overview: Tackling the most famous prison break of all time, Josh retraces the 1962 Alcatraz escape. New leads take Josh from San Francisco to the jungles of Brazil where he finds witnesses and evidence that re-write the FBI's version of the story.

videos.title: Egypt's Lost Tombs
videos.overview: With breakthrough discoveries in Egypt, Josh races to join an active dig of 4000-year-old tombs. Josh gains exclusive access and uncovers mummies and treasure that could solve the mysterious collapse of ancient Egypt's Old Kingdom.

videos.title: Egypt's City of the Dead
videos.overview: Investigating the mysterious collapse of Egypt's old kingdom, Josh completes his Saqqara necropolis dig. Opening several tombs, Josh finds treasure, clues and haunting remains. Testing results may prove they’ve discovered Egypt’s oldest royal mummy.

videos.title: Chasing Everglades
videos.overview: Josh digs deep into the swamp to hunt the lost fortune of notorious bootleggers and bank robbers the Ashley Gang; Josh needs to retrace the outlaw family's criminal empire, which included a blood feud with the local Florida sheriff.

videos.title: Mysteries of Moses
videos.overview: Looking to answer enduring questions around Moses' existence and the story of Exodus, Josh takes an epic adventure that starts with opening an ancient Egyptian tomb and ends with trekking what could be the true Mount Sinai.

videos.title: Chasing The Mysteries of Moses
videos.overview: In the epic conclusion of his two-part investigation, Josh Gates re-traces Moses' steps from the peak of Mount Sinai deep into the Israeli desert. To separate man from myth, Josh dives the Sea of Galilee and investigates what is said to be Moses' tomb.

videos.title: Donner Party Horror and Heroes
videos.overview: Josh treks the punishing Donner Pass to uncover how desperate pioneers trapped by blizzards in the Sierra Nevada mountains turned to cannibalism. In an unprecedented six-month investigation, Josh retraces the steps of the courageous rescue teams.

videos.title: Finding Italy's Lost Empire
videos.overview: Searching a city of the dead, Josh unearths artifacts from the mysterious Etruscans who ruled central Italy before being conquered by the Roman Empire. A dig site unearths clues that reveal the Etruscans may have inspired Rome's greatest achievements.

videos.title: Sunken Pyramids of the Nile
videos.overview: Josh Gates travels to the deserts of Sudan to dive the flooded pyramid tomb of a king. The murky water provides zero visibility, and the pyramid is at risk of collapse -- but the dive could unlock the mystery of a civilization that once conquered Egypt.

videos.title: Mystery of the Flooded Pyramid
videos.overview: The conclusion to Josh Gates' dive into a Kush king's flooded pyramid tomb; Josh scales a mountain to learn how the Kingdom of Kush conquered Egypt and braves the murky waters for one more dive to find the king's mummified remains.

videos.title: Lost City of the Gospels
videos.overview: Josh travels to the Holy Land to find a lost city where Jesus performed many miracles and is also home to three apostles. While investigating competing sites that claim to be the lost city, Josh reveals an inscription that hasn't been seen in 1,400 years.

videos.title: Treasure of the Pirate King
videos.overview: Risking life and limb, Josh finds treasure from the greatest score in pirate history. The most feared pirate of his time, Henry Avery stole a fortune worth more than $100 million today. Josh leaps into the frigid North Atlantic to recover Avery’s riches.

videos.title: Great Lakes' Vanished Warships
videos.overview: Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers. On their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

videos.title: Hunt for Spain's King Arthur
videos.overview: Plunging hundreds of feet below ground, Josh explores Spain's treacherous La Garma cave system and finds a floor littered with human remains more than 1,000 years old; Josh's deep dive is a quest for scientific proof of Spain's legendary King Pelayo.

videos.title: Looted Treasures of Cambodia
videos.overview: Pushing into remote jungles, Josh investigates one of the 20th century's biggest heists - looting of Cambodian statues worth hundreds of millions; Josh rappels into a crumbling pyramid and digs up a treasure trove of missing monuments.

videos.title: Cambodia's Stolen Monuments
videos.overview: A clandestine meeting with a Cambodian looter puts Josh on the trail of multi-million-dollar stolen monuments; Josh dives into a murky moat, where he unearths a priceless lost statue and a missing piece of a national treasure.

videos.title: Missing Heroes of WW2
videos.overview: Josh investigates America's daring response to Pearl Harbor, which destroyed a vital Japanese base in the South Pacific. Using brand-new intel, Josh dives in with Project Recover to find 40 planes and 200 American heroes lost in Operation Hailstone.

videos.title: Finding the Lost Pilots of WW2
videos.overview: Josh dives deep into the Navy's heroic Pearl Harbor counterattack, uncovering an eyewitness who shares vivid details of American soldiers' executions. New intel leads to a discovery that changes history -- the first US plane ever found from this battle.

videos.title: Lost City of the White Jaguar
videos.overview: Trekking deep into Mexico's narco-controlled jungles, Josh hunts for the last Mayan stronghold to ward off the Spanish conquistadors; he joins an expedition braving snakes, spiders and jaguars to uncover the legendary Sac Balam.

videos.title: Riches of Spain's Pirate King
videos.overview: Hot on the trail of a massive stolen fortune, Josh chases the treasure of the infamous Spanish pirate Amaro Pargo. An exhaustive hunt of Pargo's stomping grounds in the Canary Islands leads Josh beneath an active volcano to dive for the pirate's hoard.

videos.title: Chasing Bonnie and Clyde
videos.overview: Tracking America's most infamous couple, Josh teams up with a former FBI agent to scour a legendary Bonnie and Clyde hideout. Then Josh hits the road on a 700-mile trip through the heartland to the site of the outlaw duo's most notorious shootout.

videos.title: Sunken Treasure of the Bahamas
videos.overview: Josh helps recover the richest stash of lost treasure in the Americas; deploying cutting-edge technology and an armada of boats, the team dives the Caribbean to bring coins and jewels from the legendary Spanish galleon Maravillas to the surface.

videos.title: Lost Tomb of the Viking King
videos.overview: Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald "Bluetooth" Gormsson. The discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

videos.title: Hunt for the Secret Seaplane
videos.overview: Josh searches for a top-secret WWII seaplane that crashed into the Pacific. Now, 70 years later, Josh joins a team scouring the ocean floor hundreds of feet below to find a lost aviation treasure -- the only XP5Y-1 still in existence.

videos.title: Hunt for Alexander the Great
videos.overview: Josh hunts history's greatest treasure, the tomb of Alexander the Great.

videos.title: Alexander's Lost Tomb
videos.overview: The search for Alexander's remains and fortune extends to four countries.

videos.title: Traitors' Treasure of 1776
videos.overview: In Bucks County, Pennsylvania, Josh hunts riches stolen by British loyalists, the Doan Gang, during the American Revolution.

videos.title: Sharks vs. Nazis in Paradise
videos.overview: Just off Florida's coast, Josh Gates braves shark-infested waters in search of an American ship sunk by a Nazi U-boat during WWII. Josh joins Tristan Guttridge who has a bold new strategy to use sharks as spies to uncover the wreck.

videos.title: Lost Bomber of World War II
videos.overview: Josh searches for wreckage of a bomber that helped defeat the Nazis.

videos.title: Chasing Africa's Atlantis
videos.overview: Josh dives the waters off Tanzania to find a lost city and its riches.

videos.title: America's MIA Heroines
videos.overview: Josh dives the Ivory Coast in search of 18 US servicewomen lost in WWII.

videos.title: Hunt for Petra's Lost Tombs
videos.overview: With unprecedented access, Josh digs in front of Petra's treasury; searching for clues to the mysterious civilization that created one of the new Seven Wonders of the World, Josh rappels a seven-story cliff face to perform a high-tech scan.

videos.title: Petra's Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: Rewriting history, Josh helps discover a tomb at Petra's iconic Treasury; the twelve skeletons inside may belong to a royal family of Petra; state-of-the-art tech could finally decipher the charred fragments of ancient scrolls.

videos.title: Search for Pan Am's Clipper
videos.overview: Josh braves Puerto Rico's choppy seas to find a missing plane. The crash of Pan Am's Clipper Endeavor changed commercial aviation forever. Josh and the team fight violent storms in the Atlantic as they hunt for the plane 2,000 feet below.

videos.title: America's First Train Robbers
videos.overview: Josh tracks down the legend of an outlaw posse who terrorized the Midwest's railroads. The Reno Gang stole a fortune until a vigilante mob exacted violent justice. Josh tracks their lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

videos.title: Dive for America's Pirate Loot
videos.overview: Josh braves the shark-infested waters off Cape Cod to dive the world's only confirmed pirate wreck. Joining a high-tech recovery mission, Josh chases the multi-million-dollar treasure of Black Sam Bellamy, including coins, gold and jewels.

videos.title: 'Twas the Search for St. Nick
videos.overview: In a search spanning continents, Josh chases the true history of St. Nicholas, the real-life saint who has become known as Santa Claus. Following clues from Turkey to Italy, Josh gathers DNA to try to identify the saint's missing remains.

videos.title: Hitler's Amerikabomber
videos.overview: Josh hunts for the truth about the Third Reich's Amerikabomber, a warplane designed to obliterate New York City; ruins of a mysterious Nazi underground city and long-lost weapons factories provide clues about Hitler's dream-killing machine.

videos.title: The Man-Eating Lions of Kenya
videos.overview: Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

videos.title: The Lost Grave of Buffalo Bill
videos.overview: Josh saddles up to investigate a scandal over the remains of Buffalo Bill Cody. A first-hand account claims Bill's body was stolen and buried 500 miles away. With new leads and cadaver dogs, Josh digs for the cowboy's grave and the truth.

videos.title: Shipwreck Triangle of Greece
videos.overview: Josh dives into a mysterious Greek sea passage known as the ancient world's shipwreck capital. Chasing truth and treasure, Josh separates fact from myth and learns what makes these waters as deadly as the Bermuda Triangle.

videos.title: Treasure of the Pirate Queen
videos.overview: Josh braves the South Carolina swamps to search for the lost treasure of the infamous Anne Bonny. The Pirate Queen used her wits, beauty and daring to steal millions in booty; and while recovering coins, Josh may have unearthed Anne's secret trading post.

videos.title: Searching for World War II's Lost Hero
videos.overview: Armed with a new eyewitness account and cutting-edge tech, Josh travels to Micronesia and dives the Pacific to find a lost P-47 Thunderbolt. Piloted by an American hero, it took part in a daring raid during the final days of World War II.

videos.title: Mystery Ruins of the Stone Age
videos.overview: Josh investigates rumors swirling around a Turkish dig site that is 6,000 years older than Stonehenge. Separating fact from fiction, they uncover evidence of tribal skull rituals, debunking the legend of an alien-constructed observatory.

videos.title: Mysteries of the Great Pyramid
videos.overview: With exclusive access to one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, Josh unravels wild conspiracy theories about the pyramid. Crawling through every passage under the pyramid, Josh searches for the lost tomb and treasure of Pharaoh Khufu.

videos.title: Great Pyramid Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: To solve the mystery of the pyramid's construction, Josh joins a daring experiment to replicate its ancient build; first-of-their-kind 3D scans of a mysterious tunnel system could uncover a labyrinth of secrets buried deep beneath the stone.

videos.title: The Great Gold Rush Shootout
videos.overview: Gold Rush's Parker Schnabel joins Josh Gates to investigate an infamous California stagecoach robbery gone bad. Fighting a driving rainstorm, Josh leans on Parker's gold mining expertise to close in on the $10M lost treasure.

videos.title: The Nazi's Lost Super Sub
videos.overview: Josh dives the frigid waters of the Baltic Sea in search of a revolutionary Nazi submarine: the V-80. Hitler ordered it scuttled to prevent the Allies from learning its secrets. Now, Josh risks it all to bring the prototype to the surface.

videos.title: The Real Goonies Treasure
videos.overview: For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie. On the rocky shores of the Pacific, he finds pieces of a Spanish galleon that wrecked in 1694.

videos.title: Vanderbilt's Lost Steamship
videos.overview: Josh braves Nicaragua's croc-infested waters and snake-filled jungle to find the wreckage of the Orus. Chasing Gold Rush-era fortune, Vanderbilt's ship crashed on its maiden attempt to create a new route between the Atlantic and Pacific.

videos.title: Hunt for World War II Hellships
videos.overview: Josh searches for lost Allied soldiers on the Hofuku Maru, a Japanese Hellship.

videos.title: Finding World War II's Lost Prisoners
videos.overview: A deep-water dive leads to the historic discovery of a lost WWII hell ship, where an estimated 1,000 soldiers made the ultimate sacrifice. Given rare access, Josh assists a U.S. Department of Defense mission, recovering potential remains of American POWs.

videos.title: Death Jars of Laos
videos.overview: Josh Gates treks into the remote jungles of Laos to investigate the mysterious Plain of Jars. Navigating landscapes still littered with unexploded ordnance, he uses advanced technology to uncover the secrets of this ancient, lost civilization.

videos.title: Sunken City of Pirates
videos.overview: A first-of-its-kind sonar survey reveals a submerged pirate lair located off the coast of Jamaica. Using groundbreaking photogrammetry, Josh dives in to hunt for the $50M stolen treasure of Black Bart, the King of Pirates.

videos.title: Secrets of Mexico's Underworld
videos.overview: Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture. Deep underground, the team pushes through flooded sections and finds thousands of ritual offerings that may solve the mystery.

videos.title: Shark Secrets
videos.overview: Josh Gates investigates the USS Indianapolis disaster, which led to history's deadliest shark attack, explores the mystery of Scotland's Stronsay Beast, and examines remains that may reveal the first confirmed shark attack ever recorded.
